reports.title: Expand Energy Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: For the full year 2026, Expand Energy expects to run 11 – 12 rigs and has updated its capital investment guidance to approximately $3 billion.
During the fourth quarter, the Company expects $80 million of marketing EBITDA, reflecting the impact of the Twin Eagle acquisition (the "Twin Eagle Acquisition"), which closed in September 2026.
